steps.label: create_role
steps.sql: CREATE ROLE migrator WITH LOGIN NOCREATEROLE

steps.label: reassign_owned
steps.sql: REASSIGN OWNED BY postgres TO migrator
steps.description: Flip ownership of every postgres-owned object to 'migrator'.  Database-wide; not schema-scoped.

steps.label: default_privileges_tenant_app
steps.sql: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE migrator IN SCHEMA tenant GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLES TO app
steps.description: Grant SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on future tables in 'tenant' to 'app'.

steps.label: default_privileges_tenant_readonly
steps.sql: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE migrator IN SCHEMA tenant GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO readonly
steps.description: Grant SELECT on future tables in 'tenant' to 'readonly'.
